address: 68 Mu 4 Soi Seni Phithak Chon 4, Nong Khon Kwang, Mueang Udon Thani District, Udon Thani, 41000, Thailand
bio: Modelled on a barn and occupying a series of cosy wood-panelled rooms, this relaxed eatery with a rustic feel is conducive to lingering. Waitstaff respond to the call of a button. The menu majors in hearty Thai fare with Isan touches; dishes are cooked to order and come in generous portions. Try the seasonal gaeng phak wan with grilled dried fish and red ant eggs – served piping hot, this classic home-style dish from the northeast is deeply satisfying....
